description: State transition matrix mapping evidence ingestion inputs, verification steps, resulting trust level, and schedule acceptance eligibility.

transitions.scenario: Official HTTPS fetch with full TLS/DNS verification and network token
transitions.reason: Complete cryptographic transport attestation from allowlisted endpoint.

transitions.scenario: Publisher signed release document with valid publisher key
transitions.reason: Cryptographic document signature verified against known publisher key.

transitions.scenario: Local HTML file claimed to be from BLS without acquisition sidecar
transitions.reason: Lacks verifiable cryptographic transport or document signature provenance.

transitions.scenario: HTTPS acquisition attempt with hostname mismatch or untrusted cert
transitions.reason: TLS hostname mismatch, invalid certificate chain, or expired cert.

transitions.scenario: DNS rebinding or private IP detected during connection
transitions.reason: Connected IP differs from resolved IP or resolves to non-public/private subnet.
Plain HTTP violates strict HTTPS-only transport policy.

transitions.scenario: Network token expired or revoked mid-request
transitions.reason: NetworkActivationGate denies request when authorization is revoked or expired.

transitions.sidecar: Valid TLS metadata with mismatched hash
transitions.reason: Response byte digest differs from recorded SHA-256.

transitions.scenario: Forged publisher signature with invalid public key
transitions.reason: Signature verification fails against registered publisher public keys.
